title: Cross-functional roadmap sync prep - Feb 2026 (Asha notes)
content:
Context: prep for 2/20 cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Applied ML). Goal = surface dependencies, get agreement on milestone dates for Q2 workstreams (model onboarding, release rollouts, infra capacity commit).

Quick notes / TL;DR:
- Need firm decision on model variant/default for hosted API v2 by 3/10 (impact: billing model, runtime kernels, docs).
- Serving/runtime needs committed capacity for Dedicated + burst policy before can sign off on canary timeline (ENG-3421).
- Applied ML wants 2 additional eval prompt sets and one stability regression check in the canary (ML-128) - schedule and owner TBD.
- Action: Align on owners & dates today; follow-up 1:1 with Riley to unblock infra tickets.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick status (2m) - what shipped last sprint that changes roadmap assumptions
2) Model onboarding plan (8m) - Product proposal for default model family + quantization profile; tradeoffs (latency vs quality)
3) Serving/runtime constraints (8m) - required infra reservations, autoscale/burst strategy, fallback model routes
4) Eval & quality gating (6m) - minimal evals for canary, rollback criteria, telemetry hooks
5) Owners & dates (4m) - agree on milestone dates + follow-ups

Discussion points / talking bullets: 
- Product: propose shipping hosted-api v2 with Mistral-7B-quant/4x profile as default for general tiers, with Mistral-7B-fp16 reserved for premium (rationale: good perf/cost). Need perf numbers from Riley to verify latency P95 under 1s for 32-token completions.
- Eng (Riley): current kernel selection still has a regression on long-prefix throughput (PR #654) - can we get a backport for release branch? If not, fallback policy must be documented.
- Applied ML (Sofia): quality baseline shows ~1.8% drop on our summarization eval when moving to the current quant profile. We need to run focused prompt-level checks and add a targeted prompt set for regressions in the canary pipeline.
- Ops/Infra: Dedicated capacity asks are: reserve 8 GPUs for initial canary (1 week) + autoscale to 24 GPUs for peak. Need finance sign-off if commit > monthly threshold.

Unresolved questions / risks (to highlight):
- Risk: If kernel regression not fixed, latency SLO fails for some enterprise customers - mitigation = fallback to fp16 model variant but costs go up. Need cost delta estimate.
- Risk: Eval coverage incomplete for long-form cohere cases; possible silent regressions. Need to add 2 prompt sets (legalese + multi-turn instruction-following).
- Dependency: Product docs + SDK examples must be updated in same deploy wave as model change (concurrency risk).

Action items (who / by when):
- Riley Chen: provide updated perf matrix (P50/P95) for Mistral-7B quant profile across 4 sequence lengths by 2026-03-03. (ENG-3421)
- Sofia Martinez: create 2 targeted eval prompt sets (legalese, multi-turn) and add into canary pipeline; initial run results by 2026-02-27. (ML-128)
- Daniel Park (release eng): confirm whether PR #654 can be backported to release branch or provide fallback plan; answer by 2026-02-25.
- Asha (me): update roadmap doc with agreed milestone dates and send meeting notes + owners by EOD 2026-02-20.
- Ops (TBD): draft Dedicated capacity commitment request for finance with cost delta; first draft by 2026-02-26.

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Bring up possibility of splitting canary into two waves: small traffic + heavy telemetry (wave 1), broader traffic with cost guardrails (wave 2). May reduce blast radius.
- Ask Legal if any new model variants change data processing terms (quick check).
- Prepare 2 slides showing latency vs cost tradeoff for product execs - keep numbers simple (cost per 1k tokens).

Linked artifacts to reference in meeting:
- Confluence: ROADMAP Q2 2026 (https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ROADMAP-2026-Q2)
- Jira: ENG-3421 (serving kernel perf/regression), ML-128 (eval prompt sets)
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/654

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send):
- Brief summary (1 paragraph)
- Agreed owners + deadlines (bulleted list)
- Any open decisions and next check-in date

Rough milestone proposal (for discussion today):
- 2026-03-03: Perf verification complete (Riley)
- 2026-03-10: Final decision on default model variant + quant profile (product sign-off)
- 2026-03-17: Canary deploy (wave 1) - limited traffic + eval gating
- 2026-03-31: Broader rollout (wave 2) if no regressions & infra capacity confirmed

Random reminders:
- Bring up pricing/packaging communication for PLG docs (important for product marketing).
- Check Slack thread #prod-roadmap for any late asks from sales (someone mentioned enterprise wanting Mistral-fp16).

End of notes.
